description.value: Jim's Pizza & Pasta is a family-owned Abbotsford institution with over 30 years of operation, celebrated locally for its homemade sauces and famously generous mozzarella. The kitchen cuts and prepares fresh ingredients daily and sources from local producers, setting it apart from chain competitors. Cyclists stopping through the Fraser Valley will find a broad menu of pizzas, pastas, ribs, and wings available for pickup or delivery.

address.value: 32224 South Fraser Way, Abbotsford, BC V2T 1W8

No bike-specific amenities (rack, parking, pump, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere; takeout/pickup is explicitly confirmed, and a dedicated Vegetarian specialty pizza is listed on the menu.
